template <typename Function>
void AssertInvalidArgument(Function&& function)
{
    bool threw = false;
    try
    {
        function();
    }
    catch (const std::invalid_argument&)
    {
        threw = true;
    }
    assert(threw);
}

RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentCampaignIdentity Campaign()
{
    const std::string canonical = "policy-test-campaign-approval";
    return {41, canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical)};
}

RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMaterializationIdentity
Materialization(int count)
{
    const std::string canonical =
        "policy-test-materialization:" + std::to_string(count);
    return {71, Campaign().campaignApprovalId, Campaign().identityHash,
        kRecommendationCampaignMaterializationContractVersion, count,
        canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical)};
}

Context ComparisonContext(std::string symbol = "eurusd")
{
    return {std::move(symbol), 12, 0.001, 128,
        "inference_eval_result_label_v1;label_rule_id=1;target_type=1",
        "2025-01-01", "2026-01-01"};
}

Metric Numeric(std::string identity, std::optional<double> value)
{
    return {std::move(identity), value, MetricSupport::NumericDelta};
}

Metric Unsupported(std::string identity, std::optional<double> value)
{
    return {std::move(identity), value, MetricSupport::Unsupported};
}

long long SourceExperiment(int ordinal) { return 500 + ordinal; }
long long ResultExperiment(int ordinal) { return 900 + ordinal; }

MemberIdentity Identity(int ordinal,
    std::optional<long long> expectedExperimentId)
{
    return {ordinal, 100 + ordinal, 200 + ordinal, 300 + ordinal,
        SourceExperiment(ordinal), 400 + ordinal, expectedExperimentId};
}

SourceEvidence Source(
    int ordinal,
    std::vector<Metric> metrics,
    Context context = ComparisonContext())
{
    return {SourceExperiment(ordinal), 600 + ordinal, 700 + ordinal,
        std::move(context), MetricCollection(std::move(metrics))};
}

ResultEvidence Result(
    int ordinal,
    std::vector<Metric> metrics,
    Context context = ComparisonContext())
{
    return {ResultExperiment(ordinal), 1000 + ordinal,
        {ResultIdentity("experiment_analysis_result", 2000 + ordinal)},
        std::move(context), MetricCollection(std::move(metrics))};
}

std::vector<Metric> SourceMetrics()
{
    return {Numeric("inference_accuracy", 0.70),
        Numeric("leader_score", 0.80)};
}

std::vector<Metric> FavorableMetrics()
{
    return {Numeric("inference_accuracy", 0.75),
        Numeric("leader_score", 0.82)};
}

std::vector<Metric> UnfavorableMetrics()
{
    return {Numeric("inference_accuracy", 0.65),
        Numeric("leader_score", 0.78)};
}

std::vector<Metric> NeutralMetrics()
{
    return {Numeric("inference_accuracy", 0.70),
        Numeric("leader_score", 0.80)};
}

MemberEvidence Succeeded(
    int ordinal,
    std::vector<Metric> sourceMetrics,
    std::vector<Metric> resultMetrics,
    Context sourceContext = ComparisonContext(),
    Context resultContext = ComparisonContext())
{
    return {Identity(ordinal, ResultExperiment(ordinal)),
        Lifecycle::Succeeded,
        Source(ordinal, std::move(sourceMetrics), std::move(sourceContext)),
        Result(ordinal, std::move(resultMetrics), std::move(resultContext))};
}

MemberEvidence Comparable(int ordinal)
{
    return Succeeded(ordinal, SourceMetrics(), FavorableMetrics());
}

MemberEvidence Terminal(int ordinal, Lifecycle lifecycle)
{
    return {Identity(ordinal, ResultExperiment(ordinal)), lifecycle,
        std::nullopt, std::nullopt};
}

Assessment Assess(
    std::vector<MemberEvidence> members,
    std::string observedAt = "2026-07-20 12:00:00+00")
{
    return BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment(Campaign(),
        Materialization(static_cast<int>(members.size())), observedAt,
        members);
}

Decision Decide(
    std::vector<MemberEvidence> members,
    const Policy& policy = BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy())
{
    return ApplyRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
        policy, Assess(std::move(members)));
}

bool HasReason(
    const std::vector<PolicyReason>& reasons,
    PolicyReason reason)
{
    return std::find(reasons.begin(), reasons.end(), reason) != reasons.end();
}

const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation& Evaluation(
    const Decision& decision,
    int memberOrdinal,
    const std::string& metricIdentity)
{
    const auto& member = decision.members.at(
        static_cast<std::size_t>(memberOrdinal - 1));
    const auto found = std::find_if(member.metricEvaluations.begin(),
        member.metricEvaluations.end(), [&](const auto& evaluation)
    {
        return evaluation.metricIdentity == metricIdentity;
    });
    assert(found != member.metricEvaluations.end());
    return *found;
}

int main()
{
    const Policy defaultPolicy =
        BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy();
    assert(defaultPolicy.identity.contractVersion ==
        kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion);
    assert(defaultPolicy.identity.hash ==
        RecommendationCanonicalHash(defaultPolicy.identity.canonicalText));
    assert(defaultPolicy.requiredMetricRules.size() == 2);
    assert(defaultPolicy.requiredMetricRules[0].metricIdentity ==
        "inference_accuracy");
    assert(defaultPolicy.requiredMetricRules[1].metricIdentity ==
        "leader_score");

    PolicyInput reorderedPolicyInput;
    std::reverse(reorderedPolicyInput.requiredMetricRules.begin(),
        reorderedPolicyInput.requiredMetricRules.end());
    assert(BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(reorderedPolicyInput) ==
        defaultPolicy);
    PolicyInput duplicatePolicyInput;
    duplicatePolicyInput.requiredMetricRules.push_back(
        duplicatePolicyInput.requiredMetricRules.front());
    AssertInvalidArgument([&]
    {
        (void)BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
            duplicatePolicyInput);
    });
    PolicyInput unsupportedVersion;
    unsupportedVersion.contractVersion = 999;
    AssertInvalidArgument([&]
    {
        (void)BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(unsupportedVersion);
    });
    PolicyInput invalidMinimum;
    invalidMinimum.minimumComparableMemberCount = 0;
    AssertInvalidArgument([&]
    {
        (void)BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(invalidMinimum);
    });
    PolicyInput emptyRules;
    emptyRules.requiredMetricRules.clear();
    AssertInvalidArgument([&]
    {
        (void)BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(emptyRules);
    });
    PolicyInput invalidDirection;
    invalidDirection.requiredMetricRules[0].direction =
        static_cast<Direction>(999);
    AssertInvalidArgument([&]
    {
        (void)BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(invalidDirection);
    });
    AssertInvalidArgument([]
    {
        (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirectionText(
            static_cast<Direction>(999));
    });
    AssertInvalidArgument([]
    {
        (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyCampaignInterpretationText(
            static_cast<CampaignInterpretation>(999));
    });
    AssertInvalidArgument([]
    {
        (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyReasonText(
            static_cast<PolicyReason>(999));
    });

    // A complete comparable campaign is interpreted without turning the
    // advisory eligibility result into authority.
    const Decision favorable = Decide({Comparable(1)});
    assert(favorable.assessmentContractVersion ==
        kRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentContractVersion);
    assert(favorable.assessmentIdentityHash ==
        RecommendationCanonicalHash(favorable.assessmentCanonicalText));
    assert(favorable.campaignIdentity == Campaign());
    assert(favorable.materializationIdentity == Materialization(1));
    assert(favorable.summary.evidenceSufficiency ==
        EvidenceSufficiency::Sufficient);
    assert(favorable.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
        CampaignInterpretation::Favorable);
    assert(favorable.summary.followUpEligibility ==
        FollowUpEligibility::EligibleForOperatorReview);
    assert(!favorable.summary.followUpAuthorized);
    assert(favorable.summary.comparableMemberCount == 1);
    assert(favorable.summary.favorableMetricCount == 2);
    assert(favorable.members[0].evidenceClassification ==
        EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable);
    assert(favorable.members[0].interpretation ==
        MemberInterpretation::Favorable);
    assert(Evaluation(favorable, 1, "inference_accuracy").judgment ==
        MetricJudgment::Favorable);
    assert(favorable.identity.canonicalText.find(
        "follow_up_authorized=false") != std::string::npos);
    assert(favorable.identity.canonicalText.find(
        "assessment_canonical=") != std::string::npos);
    assert(favorable.identity.hash ==
        RecommendationCanonicalHash(favorable.identity.canonicalText));

    const Decision mixedMetrics = Decide({Succeeded(1, SourceMetrics(),
        {Numeric("inference_accuracy", 0.75),
            Numeric("leader_score", 0.78)})});
    assert(mixedMetrics.summary.evidenceSufficiency ==
        EvidenceSufficiency::Sufficient);
    assert(mixedMetrics.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
        CampaignInterpretation::Mixed);
    assert(mixedMetrics.members[0].interpretation ==
        MemberInterpretation::Mixed);
    assert(mixedMetrics.summary.favorableMetricCount == 1);
    assert(mixedMetrics.summary.unfavorableMetricCount == 1);

    const Decision neutral = Decide({Succeeded(1, SourceMetrics(),
        NeutralMetrics())});
    assert(neutral.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
        CampaignInterpretation::Neutral);
    assert(neutral.summary.neutralMetricCount == 2);
    assert(Evaluation(neutral, 1, "leader_score").assessmentDelta ==
        std::optional<double>{0.0});

    const Decision unfavorable = Decide({Succeeded(1, SourceMetrics(),
        UnfavorableMetrics())});
    assert(unfavorable.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
        CampaignInterpretation::Unfavorable);
    assert(unfavorable.summary.unfavorableMetricCount == 2);

    PolicyInput lowerIsFavorableInput;
    lowerIsFavorableInput.requiredMetricRules = {
        {"loss", Direction::LowerIsFavorable}};
    const Policy lowerIsFavorable =
        BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(lowerIsFavorableInput);
    const Decision lowerResult = Decide({Succeeded(1,
        {Numeric("loss", 1.0)}, {Numeric("loss", 0.5)})},
        lowerIsFavorable);
    assert(lowerResult.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
        CampaignInterpretation::Favorable);
    assert(Evaluation(lowerResult, 1, "loss").assessmentDelta ==
        std::optional<double>{-0.5});
    assert(Evaluation(lowerResult, 1, "loss").judgment ==
        MetricJudgment::Favorable);

    PolicyInput minimumTwoInput;
    minimumTwoInput.minimumComparableMemberCount = 2;
    const Decision minimumNotMet = Decide({Comparable(1)},
        BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(minimumTwoInput));
    assert(minimumNotMet.summary.evidenceSufficiency ==
        EvidenceSufficiency::Insufficient);
    assert(minimumNotMet.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
        CampaignInterpretation::Inconclusive);
    assert(HasReason(minimumNotMet.summary.evidenceReasons,
        PolicyReason::MinimumComparableMembersNotMet));

    // A metric absent from the Step 5a union stays explicitly absent; policy
    // evaluation does not invent or recompute it.
    const Decision requiredMetricMissing = Decide({Succeeded(1,
        {Numeric("inference_accuracy", 0.70)},
        {Numeric("inference_accuracy", 0.75)})});
    assert(requiredMetricMissing.members[0].evidenceClassification ==
        EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable);
    assert(requiredMetricMissing.summary.evidenceSufficiency ==
        EvidenceSufficiency::Insufficient);
    assert(HasReason(requiredMetricMissing.summary.evidenceReasons,
        PolicyReason::RequiredMetricMissing));
    assert(!Evaluation(requiredMetricMissing, 1, "leader_score")
        .evidenceClassification);
    assert(!Evaluation(requiredMetricMissing, 1, "leader_score")
        .assessmentDelta);
    assert(Evaluation(requiredMetricMissing, 1, "leader_score").judgment ==
        MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable);

    const Decision contextChanged = Decide({Succeeded(1, SourceMetrics(),
        FavorableMetrics(), ComparisonContext(),
        ComparisonContext("gbpusd"))});
    assert(contextChanged.summary.contextChangedMemberCount == 1);
    assert(contextChanged.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
        CampaignInterpretation::Inconclusive);
    assert(HasReason(contextChanged.summary.evidenceReasons,
        PolicyReason::ContextChangedComparisonPresent));

namespace EA::ExperimentRecommendation

inline constexpr int kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion = 1;
inline constexpr int
    kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecisionContractVersion = 1;

enum class RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection
{
    HigherIsFavorable,
    LowerIsFavorable
};

struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput
{
    std::string metricIdentity;
    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection direction =
        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection::HigherIsFavorable;
};

struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyInput
{
    int contractVersion =
        kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion;
    int minimumComparableMemberCount = 1;
    std::vector<RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput>
        requiredMetricRules{
            {"inference_accuracy",
                RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection::
                    HigherIsFavorable},
            {"leader_score",
                RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection::
                    HigherIsFavorable}};
};

struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRule
{
    const std::string metricIdentity;
    const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection direction;

    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRule(
        std::string metricIdentity,
        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection direction);
    bool operator==(
        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRule&) const = default;
};

struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity
{
    const int contractVersion;
    const std::string canonicalText;
    const std::string hash;

    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity(
        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity&) = default;
    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity(
        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity&&) = default;
    bool operator==(
        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity&) const = default;

private:
    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity(
        int contractVersion,
        std::string canonicalText,
        std::string hash);
    friend struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyBuilder;
};

struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy
{
    const int minimumComparableMemberCount;
    // Always sorted by metric identity. Duplicate identities are rejected.
    const std::vector<RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRule>
        requiredMetricRules;
    const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity identity;

    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy&) = default;
    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy&&) = default;
    bool operator==(
        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy&) const = default;

private:
    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
        int minimumComparableMemberCount,
        std::vector<RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRule>
            requiredMetricRules,
        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity identity);
    friend struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyBuilder;
};

enum class RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyReason
{
    InconsistentMemberPresent,
    NotReadyMemberPresent,
    FailedMemberPresent,
    CancelledMemberPresent,
    ContextChangedMemberPresent,
    MetricGapMemberPresent,
    ContextChangedComparisonPresent,
    MissingSourceMetricPresent,
    MissingResultMetricPresent,
    MetricValueUnavailablePresent,
    UnsupportedMetricPresent,
    RequiredMetricMissing,
    RequiredMetricNotComparable,
    MinimumComparableMembersNotMet,
    FavorableMetricEvidencePresent,
    NeutralMetricEvidencePresent,
    UnfavorableMetricEvidencePresent,
    EvidenceInsufficient,
    AllMembersSucceededComparable
};

struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation
{
    const std::string metricIdentity;
    const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirection direction;
    const std::optional<
        RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMetricComparisonClassification>
        evidenceClassification;
    // This is copied from Step 5a. The policy never recomputes it.
    const std::optional<double> assessmentDelta;
    const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricJudgment judgment;

    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation(
        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation&) = default;
    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation(
        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation&&) = default;
    bool operator==(

void RequireText(const std::string& value, const char* error)
{
    if (value.empty() || value.find('\0') != std::string::npos)
        throw std::invalid_argument(error);
}

void RequireValidDirection(MetricDirection value)
{
    switch (value)
    {
        case MetricDirection::HigherIsFavorable:
        case MetricDirection::LowerIsFavorable:
            return;
    }
    throw std::invalid_argument(
        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_direction_invalid");
}

void RequireValidMetricJudgment(MetricJudgment value)
{
    switch (value)
    {
        case MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable:
        case MetricJudgment::Favorable:
        case MetricJudgment::Neutral:
        case MetricJudgment::Unfavorable:
            return;
    }
    throw std::invalid_argument(
        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_judgment_invalid");
}

void RequireValidMemberInterpretation(MemberInterpretation value)
{
    switch (value)
    {
        case MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive:
        case MemberInterpretation::Favorable:
        case MemberInterpretation::Neutral:
        case MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable:
        case MemberInterpretation::Mixed:
            return;
    }
    throw std::invalid_argument(
        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_member_interpretation_invalid");
}

std::string LengthPrefixed(const std::string& value)
{
    return std::to_string(value.size()) + ":" + value;
}

std::string OptionalDouble(const std::optional<double>& value)
{
    return value ? CanonicalRecommendationDouble(*value) : "null";
}

std::string OptionalClassification(
    const std::optional<AssessmentClassification>& value)
{
    return value
        ? RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMetricComparisonClassificationText(
              *value)
        : "null";
}

void AddReason(std::vector<PolicyReason>& reasons, PolicyReason reason)
{
    if (std::find(reasons.begin(), reasons.end(), reason) == reasons.end())
        reasons.push_back(reason);
}

void CanonicalizeReasons(std::vector<PolicyReason>& reasons)
{
    std::sort(reasons.begin(), reasons.end(),
        [](PolicyReason left, PolicyReason right)
    {
        return static_cast<int>(left) < static_cast<int>(right);
    });
    reasons.erase(std::unique(reasons.begin(), reasons.end()), reasons.end());
}

std::vector<MetricRule> CanonicalRules(
    const std::vector<RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput>&
        inputs)
{
    if (inputs.empty())
        throw std::invalid_argument(
            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_rules_missing");
    std::vector<const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput*>
        ordered;
    ordered.reserve(inputs.size());
    for (const auto& input : inputs) ordered.push_back(&input);
    std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(),
        [](const auto* left, const auto* right)
    {
        return left->metricIdentity < right->metricIdentity;
    });
    for (std::size_t index = 1; index < ordered.size(); ++index)
        if (ordered[index - 1]->metricIdentity ==
            ordered[index]->metricIdentity)
            throw std::invalid_argument(
                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_rule_duplicate");
    std::vector<MetricRule> rules;
    rules.reserve(inputs.size());
    for (const auto* input : ordered)
        rules.emplace_back(input->metricIdentity, input->direction);
    return rules;
}

std::string PolicyCanonicalText(
    int minimumComparableMemberCount,
    const std::vector<MetricRule>& rules)
{
    std::ostringstream out;
    out.imbue(std::locale::classic());
    out << "experiment_recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_v1"
        << ";policy_contract_version="
        << kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion
        << ";minimum_comparable_member_count="
        << minimumComparableMemberCount
        << ";required_metric_rule_count=" << rules.size();
    for (const auto& rule : rules)
        out << ";required_metric=" << LengthPrefixed(rule.metricIdentity)
            << ','
            << RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricDirectionText(
                   rule.direction);
    out << ";all_members_consistent_required=true"
           ";all_members_terminal_required=true"
           ";all_successful_members_comparable_required=true"
           ";follow_up_requires_all_members_comparable_success=true"
           ";follow_up_authorizing=false";
    return out.str();
}

void ValidateAssessment(const Assessment& assessment)
{
    if (assessment.identity.contractVersion !=
        kRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentContractVersion)
        throw std::invalid_argument(
            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_version_unsupported");
    RequireText(assessment.identity.canonicalText,
        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_identity_missing");
    if (assessment.identity.hash !=
        RecommendationCanonicalHash(assessment.identity.canonicalText))
        throw std::invalid_argument(
            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_identity_invalid");
    if (assessment.campaignIdentity.identityHash !=
            RecommendationCanonicalHash(
                assessment.campaignIdentity.identityCanonical) ||
        assessment.materializationIdentity.identityHash !=
            RecommendationCanonicalHash(
                assessment.materializationIdentity.identityCanonical) ||
        assessment.materializationIdentity.campaignApprovalId !=
            assessment.campaignIdentity.campaignApprovalId ||
        assessment.materializationIdentity.campaignIdentityHash !=
            assessment.campaignIdentity.identityHash ||
        assessment.materializationIdentity.memberCount !=
            static_cast<int>(assessment.members.size()) ||
        assessment.summary.memberCount !=
            static_cast<int>(assessment.members.size()) ||
        assessment.members.empty() ||
        assessment.members.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(
            kMaximumRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMembers))
        throw std::invalid_argument(
            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_shape_invalid");

    (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentAggregateOutcomeText(
        assessment.summary.outcome);
    std::set<long long> materializationMemberIds;
    std::set<long long> rankingMemberIds;
    std::set<long long> recommendationIds;
    std::set<long long> proposalIds;
    for (std::size_t index = 0; index < assessment.members.size(); ++index)
    {
        const auto& member = assessment.members[index];
        if (member.identity.memberOrdinal != static_cast<int>(index) + 1 ||
            !materializationMemberIds
                 .insert(member.identity.materializationMemberId).second ||
            !rankingMemberIds.insert(member.identity.rankingMemberId).second ||
            !recommendationIds.insert(member.identity.recommendationId).second ||
            !proposalIds.insert(member.identity.proposalId).second)
            throw std::invalid_argument(
                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_member_identity_set_invalid");
        (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentLifecycleStateText(
            member.lifecycle);
        (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentConsistencyStateText(
            member.consistency);
        (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMemberOutcomeText(
            member.outcome);
        for (const auto diagnostic : member.diagnostics)
            (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentDiagnosticCodeText(
                diagnostic);
        std::set<std::string> comparisonIdentities;
        for (const auto& comparison : member.comparisons)
        {
            if (!comparisonIdentities.insert(comparison.metricIdentity).second)
                throw std::invalid_argument(
                    "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_comparison_identity_duplicate");
            (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMetricComparisonClassificationText(
                comparison.classification);
            for (const auto difference : comparison.contextDifferences)
                (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentContextDifferenceText(
                    difference);
        }
    }
}

EvidenceClassification EvidenceClassificationFrom(
    AssessmentMemberOutcome outcome)
{
    switch (outcome)
    {
        case AssessmentMemberOutcome::Inconsistent:
            return EvidenceClassification::Inconsistent;
        case AssessmentMemberOutcome::NotReady:
            return EvidenceClassification::NotReady;
        case AssessmentMemberOutcome::TerminalFailed:
            return EvidenceClassification::TerminalFailed;
        case AssessmentMemberOutcome::TerminalCancelled:
            return EvidenceClassification::TerminalCancelled;
        case AssessmentMemberOutcome::SucceededContextChanged:
            return EvidenceClassification::SucceededContextChanged;
        case AssessmentMemberOutcome::SucceededMetricGap:
            return EvidenceClassification::SucceededMetricGap;
        case AssessmentMemberOutcome::SucceededComparable:
            return EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable;
    }
    throw std::invalid_argument(
        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_outcome_invalid");
}

const RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMetricComparison* FindComparison(
    const AssessmentMember& member,
    const std::string& metricIdentity)
{
    const auto found = std::lower_bound(member.comparisons.begin(),
        member.comparisons.end(), metricIdentity,
        [](const auto& comparison, const std::string& identity)
    {
        return comparison.metricIdentity < identity;
    });
    return found != member.comparisons.end() &&
            found->metricIdentity == metricIdentity
        ? &*found
        : nullptr;
}

MetricJudgment JudgeDelta(double delta, MetricDirection direction)
{
    if (delta == 0.0) return MetricJudgment::Neutral;
    const bool favorable = direction == MetricDirection::HigherIsFavorable
        ? delta > 0.0
        : delta < 0.0;
    return favorable ? MetricJudgment::Favorable
                     : MetricJudgment::Unfavorable;
}

MemberInterpretation InterpretMetricJudgments(
    const std::vector<MetricEvaluation>& evaluations)
{
    bool favorable = false;
    bool unfavorable = false;
    for (const auto& evaluation : evaluations)
    {
        switch (evaluation.judgment)
        {
            case MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable:
                return MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive;
            case MetricJudgment::Favorable:
                favorable = true;
                break;
            case MetricJudgment::Neutral:
                break;
            case MetricJudgment::Unfavorable:
                unfavorable = true;
                break;
        }
    }
    if (favorable && unfavorable) return MemberInterpretation::Mixed;
    if (unfavorable) return MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable;
    if (favorable) return MemberInterpretation::Favorable;
    return MemberInterpretation::Neutral;
}

void AddMemberReason(
    std::vector<PolicyReason>& reasons,
    EvidenceClassification classification)
{
    switch (classification)
    {
        case EvidenceClassification::Inconsistent:
            AddReason(reasons, PolicyReason::InconsistentMemberPresent);
            break;
        case EvidenceClassification::NotReady:
            AddReason(reasons, PolicyReason::NotReadyMemberPresent);
            break;
        case EvidenceClassification::TerminalFailed:
            AddReason(reasons, PolicyReason::FailedMemberPresent);
            break;
        case EvidenceClassification::TerminalCancelled:
            AddReason(reasons, PolicyReason::CancelledMemberPresent);
            break;
        case EvidenceClassification::SucceededContextChanged:
            AddReason(reasons, PolicyReason::ContextChangedMemberPresent);
            break;
        case EvidenceClassification::SucceededMetricGap:
            AddReason(reasons, PolicyReason::MetricGapMemberPresent);
            break;
        case EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable:
            break;
    }
}

+Step 5c pure outcome policy
+----------------------------
+
+Step 5c adds only a database-free policy and interpretation contract over one
+immutable Step 5a assessment.  It does not reopen source or result evidence,
+recompute a metric or delta, or change any Step 5a lifecycle, consistency,
+member-outcome, comparison, diagnostic, or aggregate classification.  Evidence
+classification and policy judgment remain separate fields.
+
+Policy contract version 1 has an explicit canonical identity.  Its default
+minimum evidence is one ``succeeded_comparable`` member, and its required
+metric rules are ``inference_accuracy`` and ``leader_score``, each with the
+explicit ``higher_is_favorable`` direction.  Required rules are sorted by
+metric identity and duplicates are rejected.  A caller may construct another
+version-1 policy with a different positive minimum or deterministic set of
+metric-direction rules; changing the policy changes both policy and decision
+identity.  No materiality threshold or statistical, causal, profitability, or
+weighted campaign score is inferred.
+
+For every exact member and required metric, the policy output preserves the
+Step 5a comparison classification and delta as optional evidence, then records
+a separate ``favorable``, ``neutral``, ``unfavorable``, or ``not_evaluable``
+judgment.  It never subtracts result and source values again.  Positive and
+negative meaning is determined only by the versioned metric-direction rule;
+an exact zero remains neutral.
+
+Evidence sufficiency is separate from campaign interpretation.  Inconsistent,
+not-ready, cancelled, context-changed, metric-gap, missing-source,
+missing-result, unavailable, unsupported, missing-required-metric, and
+minimum-comparable-member conditions remain explicit conservative reasons.
+A terminal failure is adverse lifecycle evidence rather than a scientific
+metric gap.  Thus an all-failed campaign is interpreted ``unfavorable`` even
+though it lacks the minimum comparable scientific evidence; a failed member
+mixed with complete favorable evidence is ``mixed``.  Cancellation,
+inconsistency, unfinished lifecycle, or non-comparable successful evidence
+makes the campaign interpretation ``inconclusive``.  Complete comparable
+metric judgments yield ``favorable``, ``neutral``, ``unfavorable``, or
+``mixed`` without declaring the campaign successful.
+
+Follow-up eligibility is only ``eligible_for_operator_review`` when every
+exact member is a comparable successful outcome, the minimum evidence is met,
+all required metrics are comparable, and the interpretation is conclusive.
+Failure, cancellation, incompleteness, inconsistency, context change, or a
+metric gap leaves it ``not_eligible``.  This is an advisory screening result,
+not a recommendation, approval, or authorization: the immutable result always
+has ``follow_up_authorized=false`` and ``follow_up_authorizing=false``.
+
+Decision contract version 1 binds the complete policy canonical text and hash,
+the exact Step 5a assessment canonical text and hash, campaign approval
+identity, materialization identity, ordered member identities, evidence
+classifications, metric judgments, interpretations, reasons, counts, and
+explicit non-authorization result.  ``observed_at`` remains display metadata
+and is excluded through the upstream assessment identity.  Unsupported policy
+or assessment contracts, invalid enums, duplicate policy metrics, duplicate or
+ambiguous top-level member identities, malformed identity/hash pairs, and
+invalid counts fail closed.
+
+Step 5c adds no repository, service, formatter, CLI, migration, privilege,
+table, sequence, lock, write, scheduler call, worker behavior, experiment or
+campaign mutation, persistence, operator-review event, follow-up generation,
+approval, queueing, activation, retry, continuation, or automatic action.  The
+existing Step 5b CLI continues to report the authoritative assessment only and
+does not silently apply outcome policy.

   128	std::vector<MetricRule> CanonicalRules(
   129	    const std::vector<RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput>&
   130	        inputs)
   131	{
   132	    if (inputs.empty())
   133	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   134	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_rules_missing");
   135	    std::vector<const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput*>
   136	        ordered;
   137	    ordered.reserve(inputs.size());
   138	    for (const auto& input : inputs) ordered.push_back(&input);
   139	    std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(),
   140	        [](const auto* left, const auto* right)
   141	    {
   142	        return left->metricIdentity < right->metricIdentity;
   143	    });
   144	    for (std::size_t index = 1; index < ordered.size(); ++index)
   145	        if (ordered[index - 1]->metricIdentity ==
   146	            ordered[index]->metricIdentity)
   147	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   148	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_rule_duplicate");
   149	    std::vector<MetricRule> rules;
   150	    rules.reserve(inputs.size());
   151	    for (const auto* input : ordered)
   152	        rules.emplace_back(input->metricIdentity, input->direction);
   153	    return rules;
   154	}

   278	const RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMetricComparison* FindComparison(
   279	    const AssessmentMember& member,
   280	    const std::string& metricIdentity)
   281	{
   282	    const auto found = std::lower_bound(member.comparisons.begin(),
   283	        member.comparisons.end(), metricIdentity,
   284	        [](const auto& comparison, const std::string& identity)
   285	    {

   294	MetricJudgment JudgeDelta(double delta, MetricDirection direction)
   295	{
   296	    if (delta == 0.0) return MetricJudgment::Neutral;
   297	    const bool favorable = direction == MetricDirection::HigherIsFavorable
   298	        ? delta > 0.0
   299	        : delta < 0.0;
   300	    return favorable ? MetricJudgment::Favorable
   301	                     : MetricJudgment::Unfavorable;
   302	}
   303	
   304	MemberInterpretation InterpretMetricJudgments(
   305	    const std::vector<MetricEvaluation>& evaluations)
   306	{
   307	    bool favorable = false;
   308	    bool unfavorable = false;
   309	    for (const auto& evaluation : evaluations)
   310	    {
   311	        switch (evaluation.judgment)
   312	        {
   313	            case MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable:
   314	                return MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   315	            case MetricJudgment::Favorable:
   316	                favorable = true;
   317	                break;
   318	            case MetricJudgment::Neutral:
   319	                break;
   320	            case MetricJudgment::Unfavorable:
   321	                unfavorable = true;
   322	                break;
   323	        }
   324	    }
   325	    if (favorable && unfavorable) return MemberInterpretation::Mixed;
   326	    if (unfavorable) return MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable;
   327	    if (favorable) return MemberInterpretation::Favorable;
   328	    return MemberInterpretation::Neutral;
   329	}

   339	            break;
   340	        case EvidenceClassification::NotReady:

   342	            break;
   343	        case EvidenceClassification::TerminalFailed:
   344	            AddReason(reasons, PolicyReason::FailedMemberPresent);
   345	            break;

   380	            break;
   381	        case AssessmentClassification::Unsupported:

   383	            break;

   447	
   448	CampaignInterpretation DeriveCampaignInterpretation(
   449	    const MutableCounts& counts,
   450	    int memberCount,
   451	    int minimumComparableMemberCount,
   452	    const std::vector<PolicyMember>& members)
   453	{
   454	    if (counts.inconsistent > 0 || counts.notReady > 0 ||
   455	        counts.cancelled > 0 || counts.contextChanged > 0 ||
   456	        counts.metricGap > 0 ||
   457	        (counts.comparable < minimumComparableMemberCount &&
   458	            counts.failed != memberCount))
   459	        return CampaignInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   460	    if (counts.failed == memberCount)
   461	        return CampaignInterpretation::Unfavorable;
   462	
   463	    bool favorable = false;
   464	    bool unfavorable = counts.failed > 0;
   465	    for (const auto& member : members)
   466	    {
   467	        switch (member.interpretation)
   468	        {
   469	            case MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive:
   470	                return CampaignInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   471	            case MemberInterpretation::Favorable:
   472	                favorable = true;
   473	                break;
   474	            case MemberInterpretation::Neutral:
   475	                break;
   476	            case MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable:
   477	                unfavorable = true;
   478	                break;
   479	            case MemberInterpretation::Mixed:
   480	                favorable = true;
   481	                unfavorable = true;
   482	                break;
   483	        }
   484	    }
   485	    if (favorable && unfavorable) return CampaignInterpretation::Mixed;
   486	    if (unfavorable) return CampaignInterpretation::Unfavorable;
   487	    if (favorable) return CampaignInterpretation::Favorable;
   488	    return CampaignInterpretation::Neutral;
   489	}

   822	struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyBuilder
   823	{
   824	    static RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy Build(
   825	        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyInput& input)
   826	    {
   827	        if (input.contractVersion !=
   828	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion)
   829	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   830	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_version_unsupported");
   831	        if (input.minimumComparableMemberCount <= 0 ||
   832	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount >
   833	                kMaximumRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMembers)
   834	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   835	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_minimum_evidence_invalid");
   836	        auto rules = CanonicalRules(input.requiredMetricRules);
   837	        std::string canonical = PolicyCanonicalText(
   838	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount, rules);
   839	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity identity(
   840	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion,
   841	            canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical));
   842	        return RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
   843	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount, std::move(rules),
   844	            std::move(identity));
   845	    }
   846	};

   848	struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecisionBuilder
   849	{
   850	    static RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecision Build(
   851	        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy& policy,
   852	        const Assessment& assessment)
   853	    {
   854	        if (policy.identity.contractVersion !=
   855	                kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion ||
   856	            policy.identity.hash !=
   857	                RecommendationCanonicalHash(policy.identity.canonicalText))
   858	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   859	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_identity_invalid");
   860	        ValidateAssessment(assessment);
   861	
   862	        std::vector<PolicyMember> members;
   863	        members.reserve(assessment.members.size());
   864	        std::vector<PolicyReason> evidenceReasons;
   865	        std::vector<PolicyReason> interpretationReasons;
   866	        bool requiredMetricMissing = false;
   867	        bool requiredMetricNotComparable = false;
   868	
   869	        for (const auto& assessed : assessment.members)
   870	        {
   871	            const auto classification =
   872	                EvidenceClassificationFrom(assessed.outcome);
   873	            AddMemberReason(interpretationReasons, classification);
   874	            switch (classification)
   875	            {
   876	                case EvidenceClassification::Inconsistent:
   877	                case EvidenceClassification::NotReady:
   878	                case EvidenceClassification::TerminalCancelled:
   879	                case EvidenceClassification::SucceededContextChanged:
   880	                case EvidenceClassification::SucceededMetricGap:
   881	                    AddMemberReason(evidenceReasons, classification);
   882	                    break;
   883	                case EvidenceClassification::TerminalFailed:
   884	                case EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable:
   885	                    break;
   886	            }
   887	            for (const auto& comparison : assessed.comparisons)
   888	            {
   889	                AddComparisonReason(
   890	                    interpretationReasons, comparison.classification);
   891	                AddComparisonReason(evidenceReasons, comparison.classification);
   892	            }
   893	
   894	            std::vector<MetricEvaluation> evaluations;
   895	            evaluations.reserve(policy.requiredMetricRules.size());
   896	            const bool successfulEvidence =
   897	                classification ==
   898	                    EvidenceClassification::SucceededContextChanged ||
   899	                classification ==
   900	                    EvidenceClassification::SucceededMetricGap ||
   901	                classification ==
   902	                    EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable;
   903	            for (const auto& rule : policy.requiredMetricRules)
   904	            {
   905	                const auto* comparison =
   906	                    FindComparison(assessed, rule.metricIdentity);
   907	                if (!comparison)
   908	                {
   909	                    if (successfulEvidence) requiredMetricMissing = true;
   910	                    evaluations.push_back(MetricEvaluation(
   911	                        rule.metricIdentity, rule.direction, std::nullopt,
   912	                        std::nullopt, MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable));
   913	                    continue;
   914	                }
   915	                if (comparison->classification !=
   916	                        AssessmentClassification::Comparable ||
   917	                    !comparison->delta)
   918	                {
   919	                    if (successfulEvidence)
   920	                        requiredMetricNotComparable = true;
   921	                    evaluations.push_back(MetricEvaluation(
   922	                        rule.metricIdentity, rule.direction,
   923	                        comparison->classification, std::nullopt,
   924	                        MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable));
   925	                    continue;
   926	                }
   927	                evaluations.push_back(MetricEvaluation(rule.metricIdentity,
   928	                    rule.direction, comparison->classification,
   929	                    comparison->delta,
   930	                    JudgeDelta(*comparison->delta, rule.direction)));
   931	            }
   932	
   933	            MemberInterpretation interpretation =
   934	                MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   935	            if (classification == EvidenceClassification::TerminalFailed)
   936	                interpretation = MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable;
   937	            else if (classification ==
   938	                EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable)
   939	                interpretation = InterpretMetricJudgments(evaluations);
   940	
   941	            members.push_back(PolicyMember(assessed.identity, assessed.lifecycle,
   942	                assessed.consistency, assessed.outcome,
   943	                assessed.diagnostics, classification, interpretation,
   944	                std::move(evaluations)));
   945	        }
   946	
   947	        if (requiredMetricMissing)
   948	        {
   949	            AddReason(evidenceReasons, PolicyReason::RequiredMetricMissing);
   950	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
   951	                PolicyReason::RequiredMetricMissing);
   952	        }
   953	        if (requiredMetricNotComparable)
   954	        {
   955	            AddReason(evidenceReasons,
   956	                PolicyReason::RequiredMetricNotComparable);
   957	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
   958	                PolicyReason::RequiredMetricNotComparable);
   959	        }
   960	
   961	        MutableCounts counts;
   962	        for (const auto& member : members) CountMember(counts, member);
   963	        if (counts.comparable < policy.minimumComparableMemberCount)
   964	        {
   965	            AddReason(evidenceReasons,
   966	                PolicyReason::MinimumComparableMembersNotMet);
   967	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
   968	                PolicyReason::MinimumComparableMembersNotMet);
   969	        }
   970	        if (counts.favorableMetrics > 0)
   971	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
   972	                PolicyReason::FavorableMetricEvidencePresent);
   973	        if (counts.neutralMetrics > 0)
   974	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
   975	                PolicyReason::NeutralMetricEvidencePresent);
   976	        if (counts.unfavorableMetrics > 0)
   977	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
   978	                PolicyReason::UnfavorableMetricEvidencePresent);
   979	        CanonicalizeReasons(evidenceReasons);
   980	        CanonicalizeReasons(interpretationReasons);
   981	
   982	        const EvidenceSufficiency sufficiency = evidenceReasons.empty()
   983	            ? EvidenceSufficiency::Sufficient
   984	            : EvidenceSufficiency::Insufficient;
   985	        const CampaignInterpretation campaignInterpretation =
   986	            DeriveCampaignInterpretation(counts,
   987	                static_cast<int>(members.size()),
   988	                policy.minimumComparableMemberCount, members);
   989	        const bool eligible =
   990	            sufficiency == EvidenceSufficiency::Sufficient &&
   991	            counts.comparable == static_cast<int>(members.size()) &&
   992	            campaignInterpretation != CampaignInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   993	        std::vector<PolicyReason> followUpReasons;
   994	        if (eligible)
   995	            AddReason(followUpReasons,
   996	                PolicyReason::AllMembersSucceededComparable);
   997	        else
   998	        {
   999	            if (sufficiency == EvidenceSufficiency::Insufficient)
  1000	                AddReason(followUpReasons,
  1001	                    PolicyReason::EvidenceInsufficient);
  1002	            for (const auto& member : members)
  1003	                AddMemberReason(
  1004	                    followUpReasons, member.evidenceClassification);
  1005	        }
  1006	        CanonicalizeReasons(followUpReasons);
  1007	
  1008	        const std::size_t metricEvaluationCount = members.size() *
  1009	            policy.requiredMetricRules.size();
  1010	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicySummary summary(sufficiency,
  1011	            campaignInterpretation,
  1012	            eligible ? FollowUpEligibility::EligibleForOperatorReview
  1013	                     : FollowUpEligibility::NotEligible,
  1014	            false, static_cast<int>(members.size()), counts.inconsistent,
  1015	            counts.notReady, counts.failed, counts.cancelled,
  1016	            counts.contextChanged, counts.metricGap, counts.comparable,
  1017	            metricEvaluationCount, counts.notEvaluableMetrics,
  1018	            counts.favorableMetrics, counts.neutralMetrics,
  1019	            counts.unfavorableMetrics, std::move(evidenceReasons),
  1020	            std::move(interpretationReasons),
  1021	            std::move(followUpReasons));
  1022	        std::string canonical = DecisionCanonicalText(
  1023	            policy, assessment, summary, members);
  1024	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecisionIdentity identity(
  1025	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecisionContractVersion,
  1026	            canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical));
  1027	        return RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecision(
  1028	            std::move(identity), policy, assessment.identity.contractVersion,
  1029	            assessment.identity.canonicalText, assessment.identity.hash,
  1030	            assessment.campaignIdentity,
  1031	            assessment.materializationIdentity, assessment.observedAt,
  1032	            std::move(summary), std::move(members));
  1033	    }
  1034	};

   118	void CanonicalizeReasons(std::vector<PolicyReason>& reasons)
   119	{
   120	    std::sort(reasons.begin(), reasons.end(),
   121	        [](PolicyReason left, PolicyReason right)
   122	    {
   123	        return static_cast<int>(left) < static_cast<int>(right);
   124	    });
   125	    reasons.erase(std::unique(reasons.begin(), reasons.end()), reasons.end());
   126	}

   128	std::vector<MetricRule> CanonicalRules(
   129	    const std::vector<RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput>&
   130	        inputs)
   131	{
   132	    if (inputs.empty())
   133	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   134	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_rules_missing");
   135	    std::vector<const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricRuleInput*>
   136	        ordered;
   137	    ordered.reserve(inputs.size());
   138	    for (const auto& input : inputs) ordered.push_back(&input);
   139	    std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(),
   140	        [](const auto* left, const auto* right)
   141	    {
   142	        return left->metricIdentity < right->metricIdentity;
   143	    });
   144	    for (std::size_t index = 1; index < ordered.size(); ++index)
   145	        if (ordered[index - 1]->metricIdentity ==
   146	            ordered[index]->metricIdentity)
   147	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   148	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_rule_duplicate");
   149	    std::vector<MetricRule> rules;
   150	    rules.reserve(inputs.size());
   151	    for (const auto* input : ordered)
   152	        rules.emplace_back(input->metricIdentity, input->direction);
   153	    return rules;
   154	}

   278	const RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMetricComparison* FindComparison(
   279	    const AssessmentMember& member,
   280	    const std::string& metricIdentity)
   281	{
   282	    const auto found = std::lower_bound(member.comparisons.begin(),
   283	        member.comparisons.end(), metricIdentity,
   284	        [](const auto& comparison, const std::string& identity)
   285	    {
   286	        return comparison.metricIdentity < identity;
   287	    });
   288	    return found != member.comparisons.end() &&
   289	            found->metricIdentity == metricIdentity
   290	        ? &*found
   291	        : nullptr;
   292	}

   294	MetricJudgment JudgeDelta(double delta, MetricDirection direction)
   295	{
   296	    if (delta == 0.0) return MetricJudgment::Neutral;
   297	    const bool favorable = direction == MetricDirection::HigherIsFavorable
   298	        ? delta > 0.0
   299	        : delta < 0.0;
   300	    return favorable ? MetricJudgment::Favorable
   301	                     : MetricJudgment::Unfavorable;
   302	}
   303	
   304	MemberInterpretation InterpretMetricJudgments(
   305	    const std::vector<MetricEvaluation>& evaluations)
   306	{
   307	    bool favorable = false;
   308	    bool unfavorable = false;
   309	    for (const auto& evaluation : evaluations)
   310	    {
   311	        switch (evaluation.judgment)
   312	        {
   313	            case MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable:
   314	                return MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   315	            case MetricJudgment::Favorable:
   316	                favorable = true;
   317	                break;
   318	            case MetricJudgment::Neutral:
   319	                break;
   320	            case MetricJudgment::Unfavorable:
   321	                unfavorable = true;
   322	                break;
   323	        }
   324	    }
   325	    if (favorable && unfavorable) return MemberInterpretation::Mixed;
   326	    if (unfavorable) return MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable;
   327	    if (favorable) return MemberInterpretation::Favorable;
   328	    return MemberInterpretation::Neutral;
   329	}

   447	
   448	CampaignInterpretation DeriveCampaignInterpretation(
   449	    const MutableCounts& counts,
   450	    int memberCount,
   451	    int minimumComparableMemberCount,
   452	    const std::vector<PolicyMember>& members)
   453	{
   454	    if (counts.inconsistent > 0 || counts.notReady > 0 ||
   455	        counts.cancelled > 0 || counts.contextChanged > 0 ||
   456	        counts.metricGap > 0 ||
   457	        (counts.comparable < minimumComparableMemberCount &&
   458	            counts.failed != memberCount))
   459	        return CampaignInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   460	    if (counts.failed == memberCount)
   461	        return CampaignInterpretation::Unfavorable;
   462	
   463	    bool favorable = false;
   464	    bool unfavorable = counts.failed > 0;
   465	    for (const auto& member : members)
   466	    {
   467	        switch (member.interpretation)
   468	        {
   469	            case MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive:
   470	                return CampaignInterpretation::Inconclusive;
   471	            case MemberInterpretation::Favorable:
   472	                favorable = true;
   473	                break;
   474	            case MemberInterpretation::Neutral:
   475	                break;
   476	            case MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable:
   477	                unfavorable = true;
   478	                break;
   479	            case MemberInterpretation::Mixed:
   480	                favorable = true;
   481	                unfavorable = true;
   482	                break;
   483	        }
   484	    }
   485	    if (favorable && unfavorable) return CampaignInterpretation::Mixed;
   486	    if (unfavorable) return CampaignInterpretation::Unfavorable;
   487	    if (favorable) return CampaignInterpretation::Favorable;
   488	    return CampaignInterpretation::Neutral;
   489	}

   548	        out << ";member=" << member.identity.memberOrdinal << ','

   566	            << ",policy_interpretation="
   567	            << RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMemberInterpretationText(
   568	                   member.interpretation)
   569	            << ",metric_evaluation_count="
   570	            << member.metricEvaluations.size();
   571	        for (const auto& evaluation : member.metricEvaluations)

   226	const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation& Evaluation(
   227	    const Decision& decision,
   228	    int memberOrdinal,
   229	    const std::string& metricIdentity)
   230	{
   231	    const auto& member = decision.members.at(
   232	        static_cast<std::size_t>(memberOrdinal - 1));
   233	    const auto found = std::find_if(member.metricEvaluations.begin(),
   234	        member.metricEvaluations.end(), [&](const auto& evaluation)
   235	    {
   236	        return evaluation.metricIdentity == metricIdentity;
   237	    });
   238	    assert(found != member.metricEvaluations.end());

  1017	            case Lifecycle::Cancelled:

    95	std::vector<Metric> CanonicalMetrics(std::vector<Metric> metrics)
    96	{
    97	    std::vector<const Metric*> ordered;
    98	    ordered.reserve(metrics.size());
    99	    for (const auto& metric : metrics) ordered.push_back(&metric);
   100	    std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(), [](const Metric* left,
   101	                                              const Metric* right)
   102	    {
   103	        return left->identity < right->identity;
   104	    });
   105	    for (std::size_t index = 1; index < ordered.size(); ++index)
   106	        if (ordered[index - 1]->identity == ordered[index]->identity)
   107	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   108	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_assessment_metric_identity_duplicate");
   109	    std::vector<Metric> canonical;
   110	    canonical.reserve(ordered.size());
   111	    for (const auto* metric : ordered) canonical.push_back(*metric);
   112	    return canonical;
   113	}
   114	
   115	std::vector<ResultIdentity> CanonicalResultIdentities(
   116	    std::vector<ResultIdentity> identities)
   117	{
   118	    std::vector<const ResultIdentity*> ordered;
   119	    ordered.reserve(identities.size());
   120	    for (const auto& identity : identities) ordered.push_back(&identity);
   121	    std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(),
   122	        [](const ResultIdentity* left, const ResultIdentity* right)
   123	    {
   124	        return std::tie(left->kind, left->id) <
   125	            std::tie(right->kind, right->id);
   126	    });
   127	    for (std::size_t index = 1; index < ordered.size(); ++index)
   128	        if (*ordered[index - 1] == *ordered[index])
   129	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   130	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_assessment_result_identity_duplicate");
   131	    std::vector<ResultIdentity> canonical;
   132	    canonical.reserve(ordered.size());
   133	    for (const auto* identity : ordered) canonical.push_back(*identity);
   134	    return canonical;
   135	}

   153	{

  1004	    static MemberOutcome DeriveMemberOutcome(
  1005	        Lifecycle lifecycle,
  1006	        const std::vector<Diagnostic>& diagnostics,
  1007	        const std::vector<Comparison>& comparisons)
  1008	    {
  1009	        if (!diagnostics.empty()) return MemberOutcome::Inconsistent;
  1010	        switch (lifecycle)
  1011	        {
  1012	            case Lifecycle::NotTerminal:
  1013	            case Lifecycle::Unknown:
  1014	                return MemberOutcome::NotReady;
  1015	            case Lifecycle::Failed:
  1016	                return MemberOutcome::TerminalFailed;
  1017	            case Lifecycle::Cancelled:
  1018	                return MemberOutcome::TerminalCancelled;
  1019	            case Lifecycle::Succeeded:
  1020	                break;
  1021	        }
  1022	        if (std::any_of(comparisons.begin(), comparisons.end(),
  1023	                [](const Comparison& comparison)
  1024	        {
  1025	            return comparison.classification == Classification::ContextChanged;
  1026	        }))
  1027	            return MemberOutcome::SucceededContextChanged;
  1028	        if (comparisons.empty() ||
  1029	            std::any_of(comparisons.begin(), comparisons.end(),
  1030	                [](const Comparison& comparison)
  1031	        {
  1032	            return comparison.classification != Classification::Comparable;
  1033	        }))
  1034	            return MemberOutcome::SucceededMetricGap;
  1035	        return MemberOutcome::SucceededComparable;
  1036	    }

   925	struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentBuilder
   926	{
   927	    static std::vector<Comparison> BuildComparisons(
   928	        const MemberEvidence& evidence,
   929	        bool& nonFiniteDelta)
   930	    {
   931	        const auto* sourceMetrics = evidence.sourceEvidence
   932	            ? &evidence.sourceEvidence->metrics.metrics
   933	            : nullptr;
   934	        const auto& resultMetrics = evidence.resultEvidence->metrics.metrics;
   935	        std::vector<Difference> differences;
   936	        if (evidence.sourceEvidence)
   937	            differences = ContextDifferences(
   938	                evidence.sourceEvidence->context,
   939	                *evidence.resultEvidence->context);
   940	
   941	        std::vector<Comparison> comparisons;
   942	        std::size_t sourceIndex = 0;
   943	        std::size_t resultIndex = 0;
   944	        while ((sourceMetrics && sourceIndex < sourceMetrics->size()) ||
   945	            resultIndex < resultMetrics.size())
   946	        {
   947	            const Metric* source = sourceMetrics &&
   948	                    sourceIndex < sourceMetrics->size()
   949	                ? &(*sourceMetrics)[sourceIndex]
   950	                : nullptr;
   951	            const Metric* result = resultIndex < resultMetrics.size()
   952	                ? &resultMetrics[resultIndex]
   953	                : nullptr;
   954	            if (source && result && source->identity == result->identity)
   955	            {

   353	std::vector<Difference> ContextDifferences(
   354	    const Context& source,
   355	    const Context& result)
   356	{
   357	    std::vector<Difference> differences;
   358	    if (source.symbol != result.symbol)
   359	        differences.push_back(Difference::Symbol);
   360	    if (source.predictionHorizon != result.predictionHorizon)
   361	        differences.push_back(Difference::PredictionHorizon);
   362	    if (source.threshold != result.threshold)
   363	        differences.push_back(Difference::Threshold);
   364	    if (source.windowSize != result.windowSize)
   365	        differences.push_back(Difference::WindowSize);
   366	    if (source.labelDefinition != result.labelDefinition)
   367	        differences.push_back(Difference::LabelDefinition);
   368	    if (source.inferenceRangeStart != result.inferenceRangeStart ||
   369	        source.inferenceRangeEnd != result.inferenceRangeEnd)
   370	        differences.push_back(Difference::InferenceRange);
   371	    return differences;
   372	}

   374	void CanonicalizeDiagnostics(std::vector<Diagnostic>& diagnostics)
   375	{
   376	    std::sort(diagnostics.begin(), diagnostics.end(),
   377	        [](Diagnostic left, Diagnostic right)
   378	    {
   379	        return static_cast<int>(left) < static_cast<int>(right);
   380	    });
   381	    diagnostics.erase(
   382	        std::unique(diagnostics.begin(), diagnostics.end()),
   383	        diagnostics.end());
   384	}

   421	AggregateOutcome DeriveAggregateOutcome(const MutableSummary& counts)
   422	{
   423	    if (counts.inconsistentMemberCount > 0)
   424	        return AggregateOutcome::Inconsistent;
   425	    if (counts.terminalFailedMemberCount > 0)
   426	        return AggregateOutcome::HasFailures;
   427	    if (counts.terminalCancelledMemberCount > 0)
   428	        return AggregateOutcome::HasCancellations;
   429	    if (counts.notReadyMemberCount > 0)
   430	        return AggregateOutcome::NotReady;
   431	    if (counts.succeededContextChangedMemberCount > 0)
   432	        return AggregateOutcome::SucceededContextChanged;
   433	    if (counts.succeededMetricGapMemberCount > 0)
   434	        return AggregateOutcome::SucceededMetricGap;
   435	    return AggregateOutcome::SucceededComparable;
   436	}

   438	void CountMember(MutableSummary& counts, const Member& member)
   439	{
   440	    ++counts.memberCount;
   441	    switch (member.lifecycle)
   442	    {
   443	        case Lifecycle::NotTerminal:
   444	            ++counts.notTerminalLifecycleCount;
   445	            break;
   446	        case Lifecycle::Succeeded:
   447	            ++counts.succeededLifecycleCount;
   448	            break;
   449	        case Lifecycle::Failed:
   450	            ++counts.failedLifecycleCount;
   451	            break;
   452	        case Lifecycle::Cancelled:
   453	            ++counts.cancelledLifecycleCount;
   454	            break;
   455	        case Lifecycle::Unknown:
   456	            ++counts.unknownLifecycleCount;
   457	            break;
   458	    }
   459	    if (member.consistency == Consistency::Consistent)
   460	        ++counts.consistentMemberCount;
   461	    else
   462	        ++counts.inconsistentMemberCount;
   463	
   464	    switch (member.outcome)
   465	    {
   466	        case MemberOutcome::NotReady:
   467	            ++counts.notReadyMemberCount;
   468	            break;
   469	        case MemberOutcome::SucceededComparable:
   470	            ++counts.succeededComparableMemberCount;
   471	            break;
   472	        case MemberOutcome::SucceededContextChanged:
   473	            ++counts.succeededContextChangedMemberCount;
   474	            break;
   475	        case MemberOutcome::SucceededMetricGap:
   476	            ++counts.succeededMetricGapMemberCount;
   477	            break;
   478	        case MemberOutcome::TerminalFailed:
   479	            ++counts.terminalFailedMemberCount;
   480	            break;
   481	        case MemberOutcome::TerminalCancelled:
   482	            ++counts.terminalCancelledMemberCount;
   483	            break;
   484	        case MemberOutcome::Inconsistent:
   485	            ++counts.inconsistentOutcomeMemberCount;
   486	            break;
   487	    }
   488	
   489	    for (const auto& comparison : member.comparisons)
   490	    {
   491	        ++counts.metricComparisonCount;
   492	        switch (comparison.classification)
   493	        {
   494	            case Classification::Comparable:
   495	                ++counts.comparableMetricCount;
   496	                if (*comparison.delta > 0.0)
   497	                    ++counts.positiveDeltaCount;
   498	                else if (*comparison.delta < 0.0)
   499	                    ++counts.negativeDeltaCount;
   500	                else
   501	                    ++counts.zeroDeltaCount;
   502	                break;
   503	            case Classification::ContextChanged:
   504	                ++counts.contextChangedMetricCount;
   505	                break;
   506	            case Classification::MissingSourceMetric:
   507	                ++counts.missingSourceMetricCount;
   508	                break;
   509	            case Classification::MissingResultMetric:
   510	                ++counts.missingResultMetricCount;
   511	                break;
   512	            case Classification::MetricValueUnavailable:
   513	                ++counts.metricValueUnavailableCount;
   514	                break;
   515	            case Classification::Unsupported:
   516	                ++counts.unsupportedMetricCount;
   517	                break;
   518	        }
   519	    }
   520	}
